scientific_question:
请对以下已经指定的单一方向问题作最终选择，保留其 B/EXPLORE 尺度；DM 的建议不是已执行的方向裁决。

At B/EXPLORE, after the two separate valid H−C observations (+.49738 and
+.52039) with retained positive G−H gaps, should FSD (A) end the limited
supplied-public-mask learning extension and retain the ordinary fixed-K2
policy-gap family pause, or (B) select exactly one fresh matched-budget
H/fair-D0 k5 comparison with G as specified in §3? DM recommends A because
the chosen learning/recurrence observation is answered and another toy
ranking would not instantiate the missing native UAV intervention. B is a
legitimate finite performance question if its decision value warrants it;
neither option depends on beating G, exact headroom, complete causal
separation or a stable-seed theorem. Preserve all positive and contrary
evidence. Do not open an unposed UAV/recast family, promote to C, or change
Portfolio lifecycle/priority/capacity. State the smallest family boundary
decided, and if B is selected retain its one-pair claim ceiling and complete
cost/stop bounds without adding a prerequisite experiment.

当前读数：B01 的训练/evaluation masters 为 770203/770204，H−C full +.49738281249999894，条件于这一训练对的回合 SE .00864640484198601；G−H full +.021184895833334313。B02 为新的 770303/770304，H−C +.5203906250000002，条件回合 SE .007576080882164499；G−H +.01084635416666652。两组分别报告，不池化 64 回合、不估计稳定的训练种子总体效应。原生增益经历真实 own-trajectory 学习后再次出现，是支持继续探索的最强事实；它并未使公开续约规则成为 learned termination。

保留反面事实：C 只是 internal-D2 component control，不是已在这个新预算下合格的固定时钟性能 baseline；G 在两组仍领先。E3 六个 competent medium/large 配对损失、small seed2 competent +.033291585、E2 duration control 和 E4 public-greedy 解释都不翻案。公开规则、不同数据、优化暴露、recurrence、team interference 和 actor 质量仍是未分离的解释。没有 tuned same-information generic headroom，缺失不等于零，也不是 B 的前置关卡。

DM 建议 A：当前从头学习及独立训练对复现的问题已得到读数，再买相同 C/H 对主要增加种子覆盖；另一个玩具性能排名不能自动实例化真正的 UAV 干预。实际 H 在 corridor 读 public regional-change flag，只替换 applied physical lease-renewal mask，保留自己的内部 D2/actor/credit。现有 scenario1 UAV 路径把连续 movement actions 变成位置、连接和原生 reward，没有 corridor lease-mask 输入。内部 skill 选择影响 UAV actor movement 是可能的另一条源码路径，不是本次 H 干预的迁移证据，也没有被选为后继。

备选 B 仍是一个合法的有界性能问题：如节点判断在同一 host 上与真实固定时钟比较具有足够决策价值，可以选择它。不要仅因该 B 不能证明唯一原因、stable superiority、D2 胜 public G 或 UAV transfer 而否定它；若选 A，请说明该有限问题本身的信息价值为何不值得继续，而不是给它添加未请求的 C 义务。不得为了产生后继，改成其他 host、UAV/recast 家族、D2 架构修复、因果矩阵或第三个相同 C/H pair。
deliverable:
请用普通中文、结论先行，在指定 response 文件中明确选 A 或 B；不要把选择留给 DM/Root，不使用路由字段或机器状态信封作科学结论。

若选 A，准确限定结束的是这次 N6/K2 大 Bernoulli corridor 上 supplied-public-mask hybrid 的有限学习扩展，普通 fixed-K2 policy-gap 分支保留原暂停。B01/B02 仍是有效的两个 B 观测；结束投入不是新经验负例、整个 FSD 关闭或 Portfolio PARK。不给未运行对象、UAV 或更大范围赋予极性。

若选 B，只选择这一个尚未分配执行的真实比较：原 N6/K2、四 zones/两 regions、H400、hazards(.02,.20)、Delta1、rho0、固定实体，不加 probe/churn/coupling。两个全新且配对初始化/外生随机性的 learner，各收集自己的真实轨迹、normalizer、reward 和 updates。H 沿现有 internal D2 c=c_Z=.25、caps40/400、age-off 的路径，在训练/评价 t>0 应用公开 change flag，t0 保留内部强制 reset。另一臂必须是现有 E3 fair D0：D2 实现路径、c=c_Z=infinity、个体/team caps 均 k=5、age-off，并真正应用其 own sampled mask。不能把保持内部 D2 不变、只给环境外接 k5 clock 的控制器称为 fair D0。保留同信息 G；G 不加载 learner。原128000-transition D0分数不能替代新的同期比较。

B 的单一设计为一个 fresh training pair，两臂各 5×16×400 transitions；每 learner 仅一次 final 32-episode evaluation，G 用匹配的 32 外生 evaluation keys。不加 C、额外训练 seed、checkpoint selection、tuning grid 或 causal panel。数值 keys/card/source 仍留给后续明确任务，不在本次冻结或运行。主量为新训练对的 full native H−D0，candidate MEI=.01 absolute mean native reward；在此相同 service-scale host 上，它表示有实际意义的一百分点，避免弱 baseline 下的相对比值。保留 post-reset、G gaps、真实 roles/service 和实际 optimizer exposure 作有界解释，不把所有回合为正当条件。>.01 支持此训练对的 hybrid 对这个固定时钟构造的局部优势；inclusive ±.01 是小/分辨率有限；<−.01 是该预算下相反观察。任何分支均保留全部 outcomes、结束一次完整 intake，无自动后继或稳定性/等价/最优 fixed-clock/learned-renewal/UAV 结论。

机器生成的本咨询新增 scientific invocations、model constructions、checkpoint loads、training starts/transitions、optimizer steps、evaluation episodes 全为 0。备选 B 的主导工作为2 learners×1 pair×5 rollouts×16 lanes×400=64000训练转换、160训练回合、10 update stages；3 policies×32 episodes×400=38400 scoring steps、96终点回合。合计102400 host steps/614400 agent observations、4模型构造、4800 learned batch calls、400 G calls。D0的1280 lane clock boundaries/rollout不是optimizer calls；实际新更新/segment数量未知。没有嵌套策略/trajectory/solver search，也没有另加科学验证面板。

备选 complete-invocation caps 固定为 D0/H/G=1200/900/60秒，2160秒合计，覆盖初始化、真实学习、评价至完成发布；这是咨询参数，绝非当前执行分配或新实验已获准。已有 H full walls为333.89/323.99秒，G为2.47/2.56秒；B01/B02三臂合计分别708.25/665.01秒。旧remote D0 seed2在20 rollouts+3584 evaluation episodes中实际runner2603.277692秒/supervisor2784秒；旧记录150 coordinator optimizer calls/rollout代入1.15×[5×(64.6+.769×150)+32×.46]得到1051.6405秒历史尺度。它不是新D0实测、当前源码的admission projection或保证，也不能将1280 raw boundaries代入旧optimizer数量。未知成本保持未知，不建pilot/profile/额外A或exact-headroom关卡；未来若选中仍走现有remote-first CPU四线程及完整cap/正常fresh admission。

说明最强支持、最强反证、surviving alternatives、所选最小family boundary及下一条观察能改变什么。你可以质疑DM的价值判断，但不能以未请求更强证据类替代此B问题，也不能悄悄改比较器、数值预算或另造第三方案。真实工具/交付缺口保持为准确缺口；它不形成科学极性。现行§11.8–11.9与本次范围优先，完整答复本身不授权silent spec exception。

这次只授权一个研究回复及其指定GitHub response/comment交付；不改main、源码、科学卡、DIRECTION、Portfolio或既有证据。完整conforming Direction decision由同一DM读入后应用；新card/implementation/execution need经Root返回Portfolio取得下一个明确任务。无新UAV/recast/C-BENCH或Portfolio生命周期/优先级/容量决定。Issue10旧P14 body和旧短blocked receipt均是历史；P25完整eaff53a回复与匹配comment已被读入，不能假装它没有形成决定，也不重发旧请求。
claim_ceiling: Two separate valid B/EXPLORE training-pair package observations. Any selected fair-D0/H/G alternative is one-pair B only; no learned renewal, unique cause, stable superiority, best-policy-class claim, C promotion or UAV transfer/entry.
constraints: Decide only the P44/P45 A-versus-B Direction question; preserve the exact minimal family scope and allow the node to question the DM recommendation on its actual B decision value.

If B is selected, preserve authentic fair D0/H/G, one fresh pair, 64000 training transitions, 96 endpoint episodes, complete caps 1200/900/60 seconds and MEI .01 as consultation-only design; do not assign keys/card/source or launch it.
Retain every old positive and adverse observation, supplied-rule/data/optimization/actor alternatives, separate seed outcomes and unknown new costs; no pooling episodes into seed replication.

No third identical C/H pair, tuning/search/causal matrix, exact headroom or seed theorem, mandatory G superiority, extra diagnostic/pilot/profile, unposed UAV/recast family, C promotion or Portfolio lifecycle/priority/capacity decision.
Write only the named new response file on current descendant codex/fsd and one Issue10 delivery comment. Preserve source, main, cards/intakes, existing responses and all unrelated branch changes.
New consultation scientific exposure is zero. No model/checkpoint load, learner/environment invocation, dependency/setup/source change, experiment card or numerical RNG-key construction.

The complete P25 response at eaff53a10b21383fb682f63bcf58782875599ff0 and its matching comment are authoritative evidence; preserve its contradictory short blocker rather than replaying or overwriting it.

Use conclusion-first natural-language Chinese scientific prose. A complete response does not excuse a concrete current owner/spec conflict; identify the conflict without silently replacing the bounded question.
